name: banka-followup
note: Follow-ups: 'after' is asked first, 'text' follows up on its answer. Written before the planner was run on them and never used to tune it; see bench/README.md.
schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE subeler (
  sube_kodu       VARCHAR2(10) PRIMARY KEY,
  sehir           VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL,
  bolge           VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE musteriler (
  musteri_id      NUMBER PRIMARY KEY,
  ad_soyad        VARCHAR2(120) NOT NULL,
  eposta          VARCHAR2(160),
  sube_kodu       VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL REFERENCES subeler (sube_kodu),
  segment         VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  acilis_tarihi   DATE NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE islemler (
  islem_id        NUMBER PRIMARY KEY,
  musteri_id      NUMBER NOT NULL REFERENCES musteriler (musteri_id),
  tutar           NUMBER(14,2) NOT NULL,
  para_birimi     VARCHAR2(3) NOT NULL,
  islem_turu      VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  durum           VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  islem_tarihi    DATE NOT NULL,
  kanal           VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL
);

gold.duckdb: SELECT kanal, SUM(tutar) FROM islemler WHERE durum = 'basarili' GROUP BY kanal
